post.title: When Automation Takes the Job, Who Protects the Family? ICESCR Article 10
key_claims: ICESCR Article 10 requires maternity leave protections without discrimination by employment classification (treaty text)
U.S. FMLA excludes independent contractors; gig/platform workers receive no FMLA coverage
AI displacement concentrates in roles where women are overrepresented (citing McKinsey Global Institute research — verify current edition)
CESCR GC16 (2005) interprets Article 10 through gender equality lens, requiring no systemic penalty to family formation
Entry-level automation exposure may conflict with Article 10(3) protections for young workers — interpretive inference, not a published CESCR finding
